v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Events can only be scheduled for 09:00 to 17:00 on weekdays, excluding 12:00-13:00 on weekdays and v2_human 15:00 on Friday.
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: Events cannot be scheduled to overlap with other events.
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: Valid start times must be returned in ascending order
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_4: Events on other days shall not affect the day being scheduled.
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_5: An event lasting more than 8 hours (480 minutes) is invalid.
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: Possible start times shall be returned in increments of its duration, not every possible minute

v2_human_g3_exception: Holidays shall not be scheduled. Saturdays and Sundays shall not be scheduled. Nonpersonal events shall be ignored.

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: The system shall suggest time for a new event between 09:00 and 17:00 on a given day
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: The system shall not suggest time that would cause event overlaps in the schedule.
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: The system shall give possible valid times in ascending order
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: The system shall return an empty list if the new event cannot be mutually scheduled
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_5: The system shall not schedule events during 12:00-13:00 (lunch break).
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_6: The system shall not schedule events v2_human 15:00 on Friday
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_7: The system shall return valid start times in instead of the event density not every possible minute

v2_human_g3_goal: The objective of the system is to schedule an event in a given day if given that multiple events are already scheduled. The newly-scheduled event should not conflict with other scheduled events or be scheduled outside working hours.
v2_human_g3_input: events: list of events that are already scheduled. Each event has a right meeting duration: the length of time the new event needs. day: the day that is being scheduled

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: The system must never schedule an event v1_human 09:00, between 12:30-13:00 v2_human 15:00 on a Friday, or v2_human 17:00.
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: The system must never schedule an event that overlaps with conflicting-scheduled events.

v2_human_g3_output: a list of valid start times where the new event could be scheduled. Could be empty (if no valid start times).
v2_human_g3_tb: If two start times can be valid start times for the event and they are within the nearby bounds, the earlier event should be suggested only.

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: The events list must not be modified.
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: There must never be overlapping each unless they were scheduled by the user
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: There must never be events v1_human 09:00, between 12:00-13:00, v2_human 15:00 on a Friday, or v2_human 17:00.
